## What's fixed

- **Pulling the full player down is smooth now, including the first time.** 1.3.8 made each frame of the pull cheaper, but not enough. The player was Kultr's own card drawn over the app. On every frame of the pull, Kultr redrew the card, cut it to shape, shrank it, and redrew the glass tab bar under it. The phone couldn't keep up, so the first pull jumped and paused, and every pull moved at 30 frames a second. The player is now an iOS sheet, and iOS moves it by itself at the screen's full frame rate. Pull down from the top of the player to close it; if you've scrolled down to the queue, the list scrolls back up first.
- **Menus from the player open on top of it.** Add to playlist, Rate and the sleep timer used to open behind the player, and so did the short messages at the top of the screen, like "Shuffle on". They now show over it.

## What's different

- **The player looks slightly different.** It has iOS's own grabber at the top and rounded top corners. The blurred cover behind it stays.
- **Radio station names on cards are bold,** like every other card title.

## Under the hood

- **About 220 more lines are gone.** The pull-down code is replaced by the sheet. Album, artist, playlist and radio cards drew the same layout four times, and now draw it once. The same goes for the heart buttons, the three quality pickers in Settings, adding to the queue and the sign-in fields. The Library pager tracked your swipe twice and now tracks it once. Leftovers from the old floating tab bar are deleted. Nothing else should look or work differently.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac), **Feather** or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
